activation_disposition.reason: STAGATE is a locally fitted graph autoencoder with no pretrained checkpoint or native held-donor interface, and no rights-cleared powered spatial endpoint is registered.

architecture_contract.native_input: one spatial RNA feature matrix plus a radius or KNN spot or cell graph
architecture_contract.encoder: two graph-attention layers with a default 512-dimensional hidden layer and 30-dimensional latent space
architecture_contract.decoder: weight-tied graph-attention reconstruction trained with mean-squared error
architecture_contract.downstream: Target embeddings are commonly clustered with mclust or another target-fitted clusterer.
architecture_contract.unsupported_selected_path: The selected PyG repository states that the published cell-type-aware module is not supported.
architecture_contract.warning: Mean-squared reconstruction of normalized expression is not a count likelihood. Reconstructed values are not observed counts and are not valid donor replicates.

implementation.revision_note: The pinned revision includes the upstream GPU-memory growth bug fix.
implementation.publication_title: Deciphering spatial domains from spatially resolved transcriptomics with an adaptive graph attention auto-encoder

checkpoint_contract.native_export: train_STAGATE stores embeddings and optional reconstruction in AnnData but does not return or persist a complete strict-load model identity.
checkpoint_contract.required_future_identity: Every fold and seed must bind feature order, graph, preprocessing, source, environment, model state, clusterer, seed, and SHA-256.

preprocessing_contract.feature_roster: The training function uses genes marked highly_variable when present and otherwise uses all genes. Normalization, log transform, HVGs, scale, and gene order must therefore be specified outside and frozen within training participants.
preprocessing_contract.expression_scale: Record the exact assay-native count provenance and the normalized continuous matrix presented to the MSE objective.
preprocessing_contract.cross_assay: Visium spots and image-based cells or panels are separate strata; an expression matrix alone does not prove cross-resolution comparability.
preprocessing_contract.missing_features: Panel absence, below detection, and filtered genes are not interchangeable zeros.

graph_and_topology_contract.two_dimensional_graph: The selected source supports radius or KNN construction from adata.obsm['spatial'].
graph_and_topology_contract.construction: Build one graph inside each authoritative participant and section or core boundary, then combine block-diagonally.
graph_and_topology_contract.three_dimensional_path: Cal_Spatial_Net_3D explicitly adds edges between adjacent sections using section order and raw coordinate distance. It is prohibited unless sections belong to the same participant, are authoritatively ordered and registered in a common physical coordinate system, and the design prespecifies cross-section edges.
graph_and_topology_contract.vu2025: Never graph an entire VLP array because it contains biopsies from four to five participants.
graph_and_topology_contract.required_lock: Freeze coordinate units, registration, radius or K, section boundary, section order, Z-axis cutoff, direction, self-loop policy, edge list, and SHA-256.

held_donor_capability.official_lane: Transductive local training on all target nodes and edges, followed by target-fitted clustering.
held_donor_capability.strict_frozen_lane: Not exposed by the official workflow. A future adapter must persist a development-frozen encoder, feature mapper, cluster or prediction head, and graph recipe, then apply it without gradient or cluster refit to one held donor at a time.
held_donor_capability.query_adaptation: Any target training, reconstruction fit, mclust fit, cluster-number selection, or query graph hyperparameter choice is transductive or query-adaptive.
held_donor_capability.multi_section: Pooling sections for training may be a valid transductive analysis but is not independent held-donor inference.

determinism_and_memory_contract.native_flags: The selected code sets cudnn.deterministic=True and cudnn.benchmark=True simultaneously; deterministic behavior is not established by these conflicting settings.
determinism_and_memory_contract.dense_conversion: The PyG conversion calls todense on sparse expression, which can exceed memory for large high-resolution sections.
determinism_and_memory_contract.required_fix: A future memory-safe sparse or chunked path must reproduce fixed-fixture embeddings within a locked numeric tolerance before activation.

safe_loading_contract.native_state: No admitted upstream object and no strict native export.
safe_loading_contract.required_path: Serialize only a tensor state dictionary or safetensors plus validated JSON and canonical feature and graph arrays. Require exact keys, shapes, dtypes, finite values, graph blocks, gene order, and no network access.
safe_loading_contract.AnnData: Do not treat a pickled or externally supplied AnnData object as a trusted model checkpoint.

runtime_contract.required_probe: After data activation and campaign approval only: L40S import, sparse-memory fixture, graph boundaries, forward, backward, tensor export, resume, deterministic seed, node-order, section-order, no-network, and cross-device tolerance through SLURM.

terms_and_release_contract.project_weights: Release remains conditional on every training dataset and annotation right.

source_evidence: The Nature Communications article, official GitHub PyG source, official TensorFlow Zenodo archive metadata, and pinned raw files were inspected online on 2026-08-22. No archive, package, model, or dataset was downloaded or executed.
